data.one_liner: Build local on-device RAG in Flutter with hybrid retrieval and PDF indexing.
data.what_it_does: Provides a local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine for Flutter using a pre-compiled Rust core. It handles document ingestion, chunking, embedding, SQLite persistence, and hybrid semantic and keyword search entirely on-device.
use_when: You need offline, private on-device RAG for documents, notes, or chat with PDFs.
User data must never leave the device for privacy or enterprise compliance reasons.
avoid_when: You need built-in cloud storage or server-side vector databases.
You require OCR processing for scanned or image-only PDFs without an external OCR layer.
strengths: 100% offline and private operation with zero network round-trips for search.
Pre-compiled Rust core via Cargokit avoids requiring a local Rust toolchain.
HNSW vector search and BM25 keyword hybrid retrieval with RRF fusion.
weaknesses: Scanned or image-only PDFs are detected but require an external OCR layer.
Does not include an LLM; you must supply your own model or API call to generate answers from retrieved context.
data.setup_notes: Run the setup command to download model packs, and ensure native platform targets (iOS 16+, macOS 14+, static framework linkage) are properly configured.
